name: private-function-history
goal: Explicit removal-commit addresses retain private functions last active contracts without adding them to shared collections

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: At an explicit removal commit, the retained private function address must show its last active parent contract and Removed at this commit. Private functions remain excluded from shared catalogs. The hosted lifecycle scenario currently renders Not at this revision.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: Existing unit coverage tests public removals and active private ownership separately. Extend the existing entity-frame render suite across retired tombstones and fully absent head entries, asserting parent contract, removed verdict, catalog exclusion, missing-parent and unrelated-revision guards. The unchanged hosted catalog private lifecycle scenario independently reproduces the same failure.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
